title: eng-releases
text:
eng-releases

deploybot: [deploy-start] env=staging tag=v2.7.6 commit=abc123 initiated_by=@maya change_window=22:00-23:00 UTC
maya: Kicking off staging rollout now, traffic shift in 3 steps, monitoring dashboards
liam: watching latency/cpu, will flag if anything spikes
ci-bot: queued smoke jobs: `smoke/sanity`, `smoke/reranker`
ci-bot: smoke/sanity ✅ all checks passed
ci-bot: smoke/reranker ❌ FAIL - 502 responses from /internal/rerank (snippet: `rpc error: code = Unavailable`)
olivia: @sre-oncall I'm seeing the same 502s on the staging reranker, recommend pausing traffic shift
sre-oncall: pausing traffic shift, advise pinning reranker to last stable (v2.7.5) while we investigate
maya: agreed — pin reranker to v2.7.5, continue rest of rollout if health looks ok
deploybot: [deploy-action] rolling back component=reranker to tag=v2.7.5 commit=def456
deploybot: [component-rollback] reranker rollback complete, post-checks healthy
liam: traces look clean now, no 502s in the reranker traces :thumbsup:
maya: resuming traffic shift, will watch for 10m
deploybot: [deploy-complete] env=staging primary_tag=v2.7.6 pinned_components=reranker:v2.7.5 commit=abc123 duration=8m smoke_failures=reranker->rolled_back
natalie: note for release notes: "staging: reranker change rolled back and pinned to v2.7.5; follow-up PR required"
olivia: scheduling a reranker patch and a re-run of canary tomorrow during change window
deploybot: summary posted to release channel, ops-runbook updated
